text:
Breathless, breathless—if I do not catch its scent from the wind  
Time and again, like a flower, I tear my collar from grief  

Would I fall asleep, both eyes from your fancy? Fie upon it  
Would my heart be patient, in separation from you? Never  

Hafez Shirazi
translated_text:
喘不过气来，喘不过气来——如果我没有从风中闻到它的气味  
一次又一次，我像一朵花一样，因悲伤而撕裂衣领  

我会在你的幻想中睡着吗？呸在上面  
与你分离时我的心会忍耐吗？从来没有  

哈菲兹·设拉子
